name: Spellfire Adept
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellfire Spark Feat or the Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Fueled Spellfire
features.description: Once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant damage, you can expend up to two Hit Point Dice, roll them, and add the total rolled to one damage roll of the spell.

features.name: Searing Spellfire
features.description: When you make a damage roll that deals Radiant damage, it ignores Resistance to Radiant damage.
